errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis represents the countries. In this horizontal bar chart, the vertical axis lists the countries.
The description states that the list of countries ends with the United Kingdom (Обединеното кралство). However, the chart shows that the last country in the list is Ireland (Ирландия).

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the vertical axis represents the percentages. In this horizontal bar chart, the horizontal axis represents the percentages.

The description states that the value axis ranges from 0.0 to 21.2. The actual range of the horizontal axis in the figure is from 0.0 to 25.0. The value 21.2 is the maximum data point, not the end of the axis.

This statement is misleading as it fails to mention a key visual feature: the bars are colored in two different colors (red and blue). This coloring is a form of visual emphasis or categorization that is completely ignored.
